decision.reason: [ev-96b59d041e80] says only "Added stats tags configuration for watchdog metrics." It does not say whether this is a setting operators opt into or tag-extraction config that Istio now applies by default. If it applies by default, the names or labels of emitted watchdog metrics would change, which would be a behavior-change rather than none. The proposed statement says existing deployments are unaffected unless they configure it, and nothing in the cited note or the telemetry section context supports that. Deciding this needs the PR or bootstrap diff showing whether the tags apply by default and how the watchdog metric names or labels change.
